method.browser: isolated scripted Firefox 153 desktop and narrow sessions
method.native: Linux release under isolated Xvfb desktop and narrow sessions
limitations: Persona satisfaction is a task-completion proxy, not measured user sentiment.
Keyboard simulation is not screen-reader or assistive-technology validation.
No production calibration dataset, process-complexity coefficient, or fab-wide accuracy claim was evaluated.

evidence: Gross 767 remains the first result, separate from 92.36% statistical yield and approximately 708 expected good dies.
The visible essentials copy identifies the required effective full-process random-fatal-defect density and rejects unsupported baseline or per-mask inputs.
No process-complexity control or default coefficient was added, so an effective D0 is not silently multiplied by another factor.
Negative-binomial alpha remains explicitly limited to random-defect clustering.
JSON and SVG identify calculator 0.2.1, preserve exact numeric inputs and results, and include the same D0 policy.
Fresh native and Firefox exports are byte-identical for JSON and SVG.

personas.label: Keyboard user on a constrained viewport

evidence: The D0 policy is always visible, wraps cleanly at 500 pixels, and does not depend on a pointer hover.
The model selector, progressive settings, and Report action remain reachable in native and browser runs.
The default remains Gross 767, partial 124, edge band 40, Murphy yield 0.92360878014683934, and exact expected good 708.4079343726257.
The semantic patch does not modify geometry, exposure, or any Poisson, Murphy, Seeds, or negative-binomial calculation path.
UI, core API documentation, SVG, JSON, and README consistently define an effective full-process random-fatal-defect input.
Schema v1 and defect_density_per_cm2 remain unchanged; defect_density_policy is an additive metadata field.
Native and browser JSON both hash to ec08342591ef2a837a7dc10b602f5866d3c78a8d6d2214309bb8920b9a971ab8; SVG both hash to 334658d9894dc0cd59811417850d90cb9807444558ed7d466e7e3449ffb31017.

Workspace check, formatting, clippy, 39 regular Rust tests, the manual report helper, 12 calibration tests, the acceptance evaluator self-test, the wasm check, native release, and Trunk release completed successfully.
The 1600 by 900 image preserves the previous workspace-plus-report composition, shows the final D0 copy and 0.2.1 report, and its Issue attachment is byte-identical to the audited local PNG.
Shipped UI, reports, README, and implementation contain no semiconductor vendor or product identity and make no production-fit claim.

findings.summary: The defect-density input basis was not auditable
evidence: The final UI and exports define the effective D0 contract and explicitly exclude incompatible baseline or per-mask values.

findings.summary: The README screenshot still showed the previous release
evidence: A new v0.2.1 image was appended to the existing screenshot Issue, independently downloaded and hash-verified, and referenced from README without deleting older attachments.

findings.summary: Scenario comparison has no retained baseline or explicit delta
evidence: Deterministic JSON supports manual comparison, but the application still does not retain two named scenarios side by side.
